text: Marquez on the march! Marc dominates Day 1 in Malaysia as Martin grits his teeth to prove fitness… 🍿 Prior to Martin’s high-speed spill at Turn 8, the two title heavyweights produced a Sprint scrap for the ages… https://motogp.io/Last5MinsPRMAL 💪 The big story going into Friday was Jorge Martin’s physical condition!
